title: KCP artifact_upload_credential result (DESIGN.md §10.10, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for artifact_upload_credential (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). Derived fresh-credential shape (gap note KG29): the §10.10 recorded constraints echoed with the provider credential. Replayable results never contain expiring grants (§11.2) — this read result is issued fresh, never stored.

credential.description: Fresh short-lived provider credential for the already recorded staging key (§10.10); provider-specific shape (gap note KG29). It is neither stored in nor attached to any canonical CommandResult and grants no operation beyond the existing upload (§10.10).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
